input.ts(3,1): error TS20910: The two values in this comparison do not have a shared enum type.
input.ts(5,18): error TS20911: The case statement does not have a shared enum type with the switch predicate.

    {"compilerOptions":{"strict":true},"lint":{"rules":{"@typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-enum-comparison":"error"}}}

    enum Fruit { Apple = "apple", Pear = "pear" }
    declare const fruit: Fruit;
    fruit === "apple";

    fruit === Fruit.Apple;
    switch (fruit) { case "apple": break; }

!!! error TS20911: The case statement does not have a shared enum type with the switch predicate.
